---
name: Documentation
about: Report missing, unclear, or outdated Scope documentation.
---

## Affected documentation

Link to the page or file, such as a setup guide, CLI reference, architecture document, or benchmark example. Include the Scope version or commit if relevant.

## Problem

What is missing, unclear, or incorrect? Describe the Scope workflow you were following and where the documentation fell short.

## Suggested improvement

Describe the correction or example that would help. For commands or configuration, show the documented behavior and what worked instead, if known.

## Additional context

Add relevant links, command output, or screenshots. Redact secrets and sensitive benchmark data.
